Backend callback selection and returned stub status.

facts.rationale: Preserves the exact numeric guard and bad-pointer defect while correcting the unsupported permanence claim and clarifying the return value using the canonical callee rather than the caller's explanatory comment.
facts.value: In the MWERKS_GEKKO assembly implementation, exactly return value 1 from InitMetroTRKCommTable selects an attempted early return; every other value tail-branches to TRK_main. The result-1 path incorrectly uses r3, still equal to 1, as the base for saved LR and GPR loads instead of reloading gTRKCPUState, so it cannot correctly restore the captured context. InitMetroTRKCommTable populates NDEV or alternate-backend callbacks and returns the corresponding Hu_IsStub or AMC_IsStub result; this is not an explicit invalid-hardware-ID rejection. The tail branch establishes debugger control transfer, not permanent residence.
